startup_policy: Only committed ACTIVE artifacts; unresolved jobs retain motion hold. Desired settings are never activated by restart.
rearm_policy: Configuration never arms input. F710 requires release and a new deadman press; web sessions must be explicitly restarted. A new operator seed is required only when necessary activation invalidates localization; unrelated maintenance preserves accepted localization without replay.
apply_admission: Command idle with fresh non-odometry evidence; close the existing core command gate during installation and discard new input, never queue or replay it. Motors may be on or off. Odometry, localization and a universal selected map are not prerequisites. Runtime activation remains uncommissioned until independently verified.

nav2_redeploy.note: If any changed Nav2 value requires reconstruction, restart this whole fixed container once. No per-node lifecycle choreography, core/bringup/dashboard/SBC restart or implicit image build.
